Fetch public-domain aerial imagery for a site

Source: R/basemap.R
fetch_basemap.Rd

Downloads a USGS National Map imagery tile covering the boring cluster (padded) for use as a boring_map() underlay. Needs the sf and png packages, network access, and a site inside US coverage; any failure returns NULL with a warning so callers degrade gracefully.

Usage

fetch_basemap(data, crs, pad_frac = 0.3, px = 1024L, timeout = 30)

Arguments

data

A data frame with easting and northing in projected coordinates.

crs

The projected coordinate reference system of the coordinates: an EPSG code or anything sf::st_crs() accepts (for example 3452, NAD83 Louisiana South ftUS). A geographic (lon/lat) CRS is rejected.

pad_frac

Padding added around the site extent on each side, as a fraction of the extent. Default 0.30.

px

Pixel width of the tile; height follows the aspect ratio.

timeout

Seconds allowed for the download.

Value

A lifr_basemap list (image, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, attribution) or NULL.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
bm <- fetch_basemap(lif, crs = 3452)
boring_map(lif, basemap = bm)
} # }
